item.title: India News Today – Saturday, October 17, 2026
item.description: Former Deputy Prime Minister L.K. Advani is in intensive care at Apollo Hospital in Delhi with a chest infection. The ninety-eight-year-old B.J.P. veteran was admitted on Friday evening. In a statement on Saturday, the hospital said his condition is stable and that he remains under close medical observation. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda visited him on Saturday.
